headline: Higher Earnings Forecasts and Opdivo Combo Filing Might Change The Case For Investing In Bristol-Myers Squibb (BMY)
summary: In recent days, Bristol Myers Squibb has been in focus as analysts updated earnings forecasts and a biotech partner sought approval for its first commercial product to be used alongside BMS’s cancer drug Opdivo. At the same time, commentators have highlighted Bristol Myers Squibb’s role as a dividend-oriented value name with a pipeline viewed as important for offsetting future patent expirations and evolving product sales trends.
